constraints: MCP tool name prefix varies by install mode, so no hardcoded prefix works everywhere
CI plugin-version-check requires a version bump for any change under plugin/
Committed server bundle must be rebuilt on version bump (handled by bump-plugin-version.sh)
context: Fixed the confirmed field bug: plugin agents/skills referenced tool names no install registers; added CI guard test
rationale: every numbered step of that skill (decide, override/reconsider, the REQUIRED link_commit, promote) used a full-surface-only tool, so the core decision-recording workflow failed end-to-end on every default install; twining_record is default-surface and routes to the same decision store, and its commit_hash/supersedes/depends_on fields cover link_commit and supersession
summary: Chose to rewrite the auto-invocable twining-decide skill around twining_record instead of merely annotating twining_decide as full-surface-only
